notes.title: Achievements Update
notes.content:
- 9 achievements have been added to this game.

Go replay the game and get all of the achievements!

Thanks so much for all the support, I have something very special to show all of you. 

Stay tuned...

notes.title: Small Fix #3
notes.content: - Fixed the issue where players would see their mouse rotating oddly.

notes.title: Full XBOX Controller Support
notes.content:
You can now play this game with an XBOX controller.

How to play this with PS -controllers?
- You can use Steam's controller settings to play this with PS -controllers.

notes.title: Small fix
notes.content:
- Fixed a window in the Suburbs level
- Fixed a grammar error in one letter

notes.title: Full Release Update
notes.content:
Full Release is finally here!

Here's everything what has changed:

- 5 new levels
- Better settings and optimization
- New mode where you can turn off hostile entities
- New game mode "The Nightmare"

Here's what I removed:
- Combination lock puzzle
- Some voice lines

notes.title: Backrooms: Exploration - Full Release Info
notes.content:
The full release for Backrooms: Exploration isn't too far away. Everything is going as planned, and I'd like to announce a few things that will be added in the full release. 

The release date hasn't been confirmed yet, but I'd say it's somewhere around May.

- 5 New Levels
- Better Optimization
- New Game Mode: "The Nightmare"

And maybe a game mode where there are 0 entities.

Stay tuned,
HNStudios
